marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 咖啡時間的自我對話 : 5分鐘改寫潛意識, 實現任何目標 | Ka fei shi jian de zi wo dui hua : 5 fen zhong gai xie qian yi shi, shi xian ren he mu biao

Have you ever dreamed of living an extraordinary life and achieving all your goals, but don’t know where to start? The answer may be simpler than you think: just five minutes a day. By practicing a simple method called “coffee-time self-talk,” you can transform your life. This powerful daily ritual can lift your mood the moment you wake up and help you attract continuous abundance—whether it's wealth, career success, lasting habits, weight loss, vibrant health, a loving relationship, or becoming a great parent. By anchoring this “atomic habit” of self-talk to your daily cup of coffee, you create a self-reinforcing loop of personal growth. A small change that can lead to lifelong transformation. Are you willing to give it a try?
